head.t: Class 4 Medicines Defect Notification: B. Braun Melsungen AG, Meropenem 1000 mg powder and solvent for solution for infusion, EL(26)A/39
head.x: B. Braun Melsungen AG has notified the MHRA that errors have been identified in the Patient Information Leaflet (PIL) included in some batches of Meropenem 1000 mg powder and solvent for solution for infusion.
